messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: billing-metering-service high token_count drift detected (8.7% over baseline) across EU region in last 5m. Auto-checks flagged delayed emit + duplicate keys. Paging oncall.
Alex J: saw it, joining. any customer-facing alerts firing?
fin-bot: Overrage_alerts emitted to ~12 customers in last 10m (ids: c-231, c-842...). Pausing alerting now. -> paused by fin-bot at 6481723490 :white_check_mark:
Sam L: I'm able to reproduce a small delta locally if prefix cache TTL extends past ingestion window. Looks like some late KV flushes cause duplicates. Miguel, can you confirm model-side KV behavior?
Miguel R: confirmed. We rolled a runtime tweak last night that increased prefix_cache_ttl from 30s -> 120s; that helps latency but when emitter retries occur the prefix cache can be reread and cause counting shadowing.
Alex J: plan: 1) switch metering emitter to fallback deduped stream (low-latency but conservative) 2) purge prefix cache on EU ingress nodes 3) pause billing reconcile until we confirm counts. Can someone run the commands?
Sam L: running fallback switch now:
```bash
/ops/bin/metering-toggle --target=eu --mode=fallback-dedup
# expected <30s switchover
```
Sam L: switched. emitter tail shows dedupe header active.
Miguel R: running purge on ingress prefixes:
```python
# purge prefixes older than 20s
from infra import prefix_cache
prefix_cache.purge(region='eu', age_seconds=20)
```
Sam L: purge executed, 5k entries cleared, mem usage down.
Priya M: pinging finance — we've paused external overage emails, yes?
fin-bot: overage notifications: PAUSED by fin-bot (reason: incidents/6481723456)
Alex J: good. early telemetry suggests token_count drift dropping to 1.2% after switch/purge. still monitoring.
Sam L: leaving handoff to @Sam L (me) for 30m while Alex steps into postmortem prep. tagging oncall followup.
Alex J: handing off to Sam L, will join postmortem in 1h. create incident ticket and set severity to SEV2 (billing impact). :thumbsup:
Sam L: creating ticket -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-6481723456 (initial notes: emitter->prefix_cache interaction; mitigations applied: fallback emitter, prefix purge, paused alerts)
Miguel R: will instrument additional KV metrics and add guard to prevent prefix TTL > emit window in next deploy.
Priya M: coordinating customer comms. will draft holding note saying we detected overflags and paused alerts; full reconciles will be performed and customers will be notified after verification.
Alex J: thanks team. follow up tasks: (1) reconcile counts and backfill reconciler (2) publish postmortem w/ timeline and config change rollback plan (3) consider default TTL reduction or adaptive TTL.
incident-bot: Incident INC-6481723456 created, severity=SEV2, owner=Sam L.
